## Research team and collaboration

These research activities were carried out within
the [Animal and Food Genomics Group](https://site.unibo.it/animal-and-food-genomics/en)
at the University of Bologna, led by
[Prof. Luca Fontanesi](https://www.unibo.it/sitoweb/luca.fontanesi/en).

My contributions are presented within this
collaborative research context.


## Project overview

Re-Livestock investigates strategies to improve
the resilience of livestock production systems
to climate change while reducing their
environmental impact.

The project combines approaches related to
animal breeding, management, welfare and
environmental sustainability across different
livestock production systems.

## My research contribution

My involvement is associated with animal
genetics and genomic research activities
within the University of Bologna team.

Specific datasets, analytical methods and
scientific outputs will be documented here
as they become available.
